invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new ArrayList<WriteStatus>, so result cannot be null.
At most, each input record results in a single WriteStatus, but efficient batching/combining or filtering during the insert may reduce the size.
Deduplication only occurs if performDedupe is true; dereferencing inputRecords would require it to be non-null.
partitioner is always used to repartition and/or provide WriteHandleFactory, so must be non-null for the method logic to work.
If partitioner.getWriteHandleFactory returns empty, the fallback writeHandleFactory is used; for the logic to proceed, writeHandleFactory cannot be null.
